purpose: Finite paired comparison of measured support on the taught placing table. Not an official grader, hidden-set surrogate, hardware bound or complete controller selection gate.
relative_reference: R1 control with archived FAST2 for the same mode/mass/COM/offset; reporting zero improvement for the reference is expected.
windows: Final 20 one-millisecond pre-release force samples mean and minimum; peak from 300ms before through 200ms after release. Normalize by known box weight m*9.81N. At least +0.25 mean improvement, absolute mean >=0.50, minimum >=0.25, peak <=1.10. Exact endpoint excluded.
geometry: Lowest of four lower-face corners relative to the fixed level placing-table top, from the box freejoint pose; sorted heights, tilt and finite-window velocity are offline diagnostics, not contact-force estimators. The log's force is a solver-step quantity and qpos is post-step; for pre-step pose relate force[k] to saved pose[k-1].
